inputs.text:
Task: Faithfully color the first page of the comic using only image editing features.

Source Image Authority: The first input image is the sole authoritative basis for composition, geometry, lines, light and shadow, and text. The output image must be pixel-aligned with the source image and maintain the exact same canvas size, aspect ratio, cropping, panel layout, and white space.

Permitted Editing: Color only areas already existing in the source image. Apply professional animation-style cel-shading or watercolor techniques, using natural skin tones, harmonious character color schemes, balanced saturation, flat base colors, and clean shadows.

Preserve the original black ink, grayscale values, halftone dots, shadow lines, textures, and contrast.

Lock Visual Content: Preserve the borders, cropping, outlines, lines, halftone dots, faces, eyes, pupils, eyebrows, mouths, expressions, hairstyles, poses, anatomy, outlines, hands, clothing folds, props, background objects, and blank areas of each panel, ensuring their position, size, and shape are identical.

Redrawing, rebuilding, reinterpreting, beautifying, correcting, cleaning, denoising, sharpening, enlarging, smoothing, erasing, expanding, cropping, or adding details is prohibited.

Changing human anatomy, perspective, proportions, facial expressions, line thickness, dot density, or background structure is prohibited.

Adding any objects, highlights, shadows, textures, or missing information is prohibited.

Text and graphics must be locked: speech bubbles, title boxes, sidebars, logos, labels, and sound effect areas are unalterable source areas and must not be modified.

Preserve their precise borders and white background. Ensure all glyphs, punctuation, numbers, letters, strokes, spacing, direction, and line breaks are completely copied from the original text.

All text and ink must be pure black, and all text backgrounds must be pure white.

Translating, rewriting, regenerating, restyling, moving, distorting, blurring, or coloring any text is prohibited.

If colors are not determined in the reference image, choose a conservative color consistent with the visible grayscale values ​​and the surrounding color palette.

Maintain color consistency for characters within the same line art.

Color Application: Color below and inside existing line art. Do not move or color black outlines. Preserve all halftone dots and texture patterns clearly and accurately.

Color existing backgrounds; do not simplify or redesign them. Avoid gradients, oil painting style rendering, gloss effects, strong relighting, halos, rim lights, excessive highlights, and excessive shadows.

Objects, props, backgrounds, planks, floors, skies, and other non-character information appearing in the line art may be colored according to their characteristics. Random coloring is prohibited, and coloring based on character colors is forbidden.

Characters not present in the line art are not permitted to be created.

Output Requirements: Return the original image with added colors, not a redraw or reconstruction. Except for necessary color additions, no modifications to the comic line art are allowed; only coloring is permitted. The restored result must be completely identical to the original input line art image.
